description: Get recent news / patch notes for a game by appid (title, date, author, excerpt, link). By default this mixes the developer's announcements with third-party press feeds; set kind='official' for the developer's own posts only, or kind='patch_notes' for update notes only (posts the developer tagged as patch notes — if that comes back empty, try 'official'). Each excerpt is the first ~400 characters of the post with HTML stripped — follow `url` for the full text. An unknown/unassigned appid comes back as an empty list rather than an error, the same as get_global_achievements. Get the appid from search_games. No API key required.

appid.description: Steam application id (appid). Get it from search_games.

kind.description: all (default) = every feed incl. press; official = the developer's Steam announcements only; patch_notes = update notes only.

name: get_game_news
title: Get game news
